content:
nina: Brain dump: thinking about a hybrid control-plane for private endpoints where auth decisions are delegated to small tenant-specific "mini-CP" instances. Capturing notes before RFC.
nina: Goals: preserve source IP when tenant-hosted, reduce cross-account peering, allow managed fallback, and make operator rollback simple.
harry: Suggestion: introduce peering pools + mini-cp instances that subscribe to a tenant policy delta stream. Pools reduce VPC peering count.
alice: Important: provenance. For managed mini-cp we add signed header X-RW-Proof with short TTL. For tenant-hosted, preserve 5-tuple and verify with attestation handshake at registration.
nina: Failure behavior: default fallback to central-policy for availability; configurable per-tenant to fail-closed. We should surface this in console and have one-button revoke.
harry: Certs: central CA issues short-lived leaf certs; mini-cp caches and rotates via KMS. For customer-hosted bring-your-own certs allowed but must register CA fingerprint.
ops-bot: spike-creator: created branch "mini-cp-peering-pools" assigned to @harry.
alice: Spike plan: two managed mini-cp instances in us-east and one tenant-hosted in eu-west. Test: outage-induced failover, provenance validation, and p99 auth latency.
nina: I'll draft the RFC with resource types: mini_cp/{tenant}.{region} and peering_pool/{region}.{pool_id}. Add policy versioning to avoid policy drift.
harry: I'll start a small prototype harness and post numbers here.
